STANDARD Measurements stay on this device.
ADB TURBO Press ENABLE ADB TURBO in ADVANCED. Enable Network Debugging in Android once and approve the debugging prompt. The app connects only to this Shield, verifies shell access, and grants its own animation-setting permission. No computer command is needed. Each power operation closes its connection.
ROOT The app never invokes su or changes the bootloader.
